excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long reddish hair, tanned skin. Wears a light orange tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, red skirt and orange pumps.
excavation_context.stage: Chiseling Matrix Under a Lab Microscope

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_3 is working at her lab station under bright magnification lamps, carefully flaking away fine layers of hard black siltstone matrix with a miniature hand chisel. Her precise scraping reveals the sharp, blade-like serrated teeth of a Yangchuanosaurus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
